# NARWC fixture source list
#
# Format: source_fileid,test_fileid,description
#
# source_fileid  - FILEID as it appears in the production survey CSV filename
#                  (without .csv extension)
# test_fileid    - Synthetic FILEID to use in the anonymized fixture.
#                  Should start with 'T' so test data is obviously synthetic.
# description    - Optional free-text description (may contain commas if quoted,
#                  but plain text is easier)
#
# Lines starting with '#' are ignored. Blank lines are ignored.
#
# Example entries (all commented out):
#
# a123456,T001,Aerial survey — Gulf of Maine
# f789012,T002,Pop-up aerial survey — Great South Channel
# o345678,T003,Opportunistic sightings batch
#
# Run with:
#   anonymize_surveys('/path/to/source/surveys', ...
#                     'tests/fixtures/source_list.txt', ...
#                     '../narwc_fixtures_manifest.txt')
#
# The manifest path MUST be outside the repository. The recommended location
# is one directory above the repo root: ../narwc_fixtures_manifest.txt
